posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Phillies 1, Braves 0. A 109-pitch shutout for Jesús Luzardo. It's their first 1-0 CG shutout win since Roy Halladay did it Sept. 14, 2011.

reply_texts.text: They had a more memorable 1-0 game a few weeks later
reply_texts.author: dubya20790.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Could not have asked for a better out come than a pitching gem backed by a classic, heroic dinger. Gives Philly Nation redemption and faith in the post season prospects.
reply_texts.author: nazman4.bsky.social

posts.jp: フィリーズ1、ブレーブス0。ヘスス・ルサルドが109球の完封。2011年9月14日のロイ・ハラデイ以来の1-0完投完封勝利。

posts.text: I’m back in Toronto this week, where my colleague and I have some important meetings. Our Theo DeRosa will have you covered for the A’s series at MLB•com.

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: No one is warming up for the Phillies. Jesús Luzardo has thrown 92 pitches in eight spectacular innings. It is a scoreless game.
posts.jp: フィリーズはリリーフ投手を準備していない。ヘスス・ルサルドは8回で92球を投げ、素晴らしいピッチングを見せている。スコアレスゲーム。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: The Orioles snap their six-game losing streak with a 6-4 win against the Guardians. Trevor Rogers produced a season-high 7 1/3 innings of one-run ball and Coby Mayo homered twice

reply_texts.text: Your Orioles and my Tigers were in the same situation.  We were wild card contenders until management traded away key players.

reply_texts.text: Damn just 6 games. Felt like an eternity.

reply_texts.text: Coby needs to be in the lineup every day. Not just against lefties
reply_texts.author: jamessusumu.bsky.social

posts.jp: オリオールズが6連敗を脱出し、ガーディアンズに6-4で勝利。トレバー・ロジャースが今季最高7 1/3回を1失点で投げ、コビー・メイヨが2本塁打。

posts.author: Jason Beck
posts.text: Even if Riley Greene wasn't locked in, you can't pitch him there. The resulting 417-foot drive is his 3rd HR in as many days, extending Tigers lead to 5-2. Greene has 8 RBIs in last 3 games.
posts.jp: ライリー・グリーンがノっていなくても、そこに投げることはできない。その結果の417フィートの打球は3日連続3本目の本塁打。タイガース5-2。グリーンは直近3試合で8打点。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: Yordan Alvarez reaching his career high in home runs is a feat long seen as fait accompli. That it happened  game 144 is a perplexing part of his prolific season. On Alvarez's slowing home run numbers and what it means for Houston's lineup -  www.nytimes.com/athletic/757...
posts.jp: ヨルダン・アルバレスのキャリアハイ本塁打到達は必然と見られていた。それが144試合目というのは彼の豊作シーズンの不可解な部分。アルバレスの本塁打数の減速とヒューストンの打線への意味について
